svg.title: The job chain
svg.desc: Six jobs in order. TSAI runs clean, overlap and dedup from job requests; the pipeline then runs apply, F2, survivor loss and the ledger; shards and the reconciliation come last. Each job reads the folder the one before wrote.
svg.text: Each job reads the folder the one before wrote

g.text: pinned by sha256 from one job to the next
a TSAI job's folder is "adopted"; the runner checks it before going on
